items.title: Nutanix falls after strong quarter as CEO succession and guidance create uncertainty
items.summary: Nutanix reported 15% recurring revenue growth and sharply improved operating profitability. Its board announced a CEO search, while annual revenue guidance fell slightly short of consensus. Shares declined about 9% in early extended trading, with subsequent reports showing a smaller decline. Succession and forward demand remain key risks.

observations.label: Nov 24 after-hours report at 4:18 PM EST
observations.value: Approximately -9%; subsequent report approximately -6%; extended trading, not closing data.

observations.label: Q1 FY2027
observations.value: Revenue $772.4M (+15% YoY); ARR $2.63B (+15%); GAAP operating margin 18.5% versus 7.4%; free cash flow $209.3M versus $174.5M.

observations.label: FY2027 revenue guidance
observations.value: $3.18B–$3.23B, midpoint below reported $3.22B consensus.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: CEO succession, retention, bookings, recurring revenue and margins; sustained weakening of demand or leadership execution would undermine dislocation thesis.

items.key_finding: Strong current operations contrast with succession uncertainty and a modest forward guidance shortfall.

items.title: Autodesk beats estimates and raises outlook, but shares fall in extended trading
items.summary: Autodesk reported revenue growth of 17%, strong cash generation and raised annual guidance. Engineering and construction demand supported results, while investors remain concerned about slowing growth in near-term contracted revenue and AI competition. Shares fell approximately 4% in early after-hours trading.

observations.label: Nov 24 after-hours report at 4:10 PM EST
observations.value: Approximately -4%; Barron's subsequently reported around -3.5%; not a closing price.

observations.label: Q3 FY2027
observations.value: Revenue $2.16B (+17% YoY); adjusted operating margin 39%; free cash flow $505M (+17%); adjusted EPS $3.20.

observations.label: Demand and outlook
observations.value: Architecture, engineering and construction revenue +19%; manufacturing revenue +13%; FY revenue guidance $8.36B–$8.375B; near-term contracted revenue growth 10%.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Organic growth, renewals, current remaining performance obligations, engineering AI monetization, acquisition integration; deteriorating renewals or margins weaken the fundamental case.

items.key_finding: Strong realized earnings and engineering demand contrast with concerns about forward subscription growth and AI competition.

items.title: Dell raises FY2027 outlook as AI server backlog reaches $132.3 billion
items.summary: Dell reported quarterly revenue of $54.94 billion and adjusted EPS of $9.45, substantially above expectations. AI orders and backlog reached record levels, and management raised annual revenue guidance to $202 billion. Shares recovered modestly after hours following a severe regular-session decline. Financing, power availability and backlog conversion remain key risks.

observations.label: November 24 post-close earnings
observations.value: Revenue $54.94B; adjusted EPS $9.45 vs consensus approximately $6.60; quarterly AI orders $60.2B; backlog $132.3B.

observations.label: Revenue outlook
observations.value: FY2027 revenue $202B vs prior $192B; AI server revenue guidance $78B vs $74B; traditional servers and networking quarterly revenue +235% YoY.

observations.label: Reported price reaction, early after-hours November 24
observations.value: Investor's Business Daily reported more than 13% regular-session decline and more than 2% after-hours gain; not independently verified closing prices.

observations.label: Risks and next indicators
observations.value: Customer financing, power and land readiness, order conversion, shipment timing, margins, cash generation and earnings call.

items.key_finding: Record orders and raised guidance support continued AI infrastructure demand, while deployment and financing risks remain.

sources.title: Investor's Business Daily earnings and share reaction

items.title: Workday reports tripling of new AI contract value and raises guidance
items.summary: Workday reported nearly $150 million in new AI annual contract value, more than triple the year-earlier amount. Subscription revenue and free cash flow increased, and management raised annual subscription revenue and margin guidance. The disclosure indicates commercial enterprise AI adoption, but contract value is not recognized revenue.

observations.label: November 24 4:02 PM EST earnings release
observations.value: Quarterly total revenue $2.705B (+11.2% YoY); subscription revenue $2.532B (+12.8%); adjusted EPS $2.82; free cash flow $691M vs $550M.

observations.label: Commercial AI adoption
observations.value: Nearly $150M new AI annual contract value, over 3x year-earlier level; not recognized revenue.

observations.label: Full-year guidance
observations.value: Subscription revenue $9.958B, +13%; adjusted operating margin 31.5%; both raised.

observations.label: Price and risks
observations.value: Post-release share reaction not independently established; monitor contract conversion, renewal rates, deployment costs and margins.

items.key_finding: Workday's AI contract growth supplies evidence of enterprise AI monetization beyond infrastructure spending.

sources.title: Workday earnings release via PRNewswire and MarketScreener

items.title: Analog Devices falls over 16% despite record revenue and $5.5 billion annual free cash flow
items.summary: Analog Devices reported record fiscal-year revenue and substantial free cash flow, with most growth coming from non-AI markets. Shares fell sharply after a mixed forward outlook and inventory concerns. The dislocation merits monitoring, but elevated valuation and weaker future earnings remain risks.

observations.label: Nov 24 12:56 PM EST intraday
observations.value: $316.75, -16.37%; not a closing price.

observations.label: FY2026 results
observations.value: Revenue $15.2B, +38% YoY; free cash flow $5.5B, 36% of revenue; over two-thirds of growth came from non-AI-centric markets.

observations.label: Forward outlook
observations.value: Q1 adjusted EPS midpoint $3.82 versus analyst estimate around $3.89; revenue midpoint $4.4B; inventory days reported at 141.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Industrial and automotive orders, inventory normalization, margin guidance and earnings revisions; material deterioration would weaken the dislocation thesis.

items.key_finding: Strong cash generation and diversified growth contrast with an outsized selloff, but forward profit and inventory risks are real.
